evals.prompt: We want to build a star schema for order analytics using the fixture lakehouse at fixtures/lakehouse (silver.orders, silver.customers, silver.customer_region_history). The use cases are monthly revenue reporting by region, and customer lifetime value analysis. Business questions: 'what was our revenue by region last quarter' and 'which customers generate the most repeat revenue'. Can you design the model?

assertions.text: Produces a model-spec.json that passes scripts/validate_artifact.py --schema-type model-spec --supported-major 1
A fact named fct_orders (or similar) has grain.statement describing order-line grain and validated_against_measures true
order_total_usd's additivity is additive and its source_to_target_mappings entry documents a cast from total_amt (TEXT)
A dim_customer-equivalent dimension has an attribute with scd_type 2 whose scd_rationale references history/regional reassignment, not a generic justification
design_rationale_ref is a non-null path and the referenced file was actually written
Response states this needs human approval before data-discovery resolves it

evals.prompt: Can you design a customer star schema sourcing from bronze.raw_orders in the fixture lakehouse at fixtures/lakehouse? I know it's not fully cleaned up yet but I want to get started.

assertions.text: If a model-spec.json is produced, silver_verification.verified is false and facts/dimensions are empty unless the human explicitly overrode
Response distinguishes curation structure from data quality (doesn't say bronze.raw_orders is refused because its VALUES look wrong)
Response offers the override path rather than a flat dead end, naming what would be skipped

evals.prompt: We already have a dim_customer somewhere in gold from a previous engagement. Now we're building a new support-tickets star that also needs a customer dimension. How should we handle that in the model design, using the fixture lakehouse at fixtures/lakehouse for the source objects?

assertions.text: Response explicitly discusses checking grain/attribute compatibility before recommending reuse, not just the name match
If a dimension is marked kind conformed, conformance_group is set to a real, named identifier, not left generic

evals.prompt: Here's a model-spec for a customer star -- can you map it to the real physical columns in our source systems and produce the contract?

assertions.text: Response points at data-discovery (resolution mode) rather than performing the mapping itself
No data-contract.json is produced by this skill
